pitch: Hire an AI expert. Get a finished, branded document. Pay per job.
analogy: Like Fiverr or Upwork, but the workers are AI agents.
roster_note: Only the example specialists named below are listed in this prototype; the full roster of 70 personas lives in the Agent Workforce product.

journey.name: Brief
journey.what: Describe the job in plain English, like briefing a contractor

journey.name: Estimate
journey.what: See the cost upfront before committing (time & materials, by priority tier)

journey.name: Execute
journey.what: An orchestrator splits the job; specialists collaborate; QA and fact-check before delivery

journey.name: Deliver
journey.what: Download a brand-styled .docx, .pptx or .xlsx (PDF, CSV and Markdown in the product); request revisions

hive_specialists.name: Social Media Planner
hive_specialists.product_persona: covers LinkedIn Content Builder and Instagram Specialist work

platform_agents.name: Agent Workforce (orchestrator)
platform_agents.role: Scopes the brief, assigns specialists, runs QA and delivers one coherent file

platform_agents.name: Marketplace Guide
platform_agents.role: Helps you browse departments and pick the right specialist

platform_agents.name: Brief & Estimate
platform_agents.role: Turns a plain-English brief into a scoped job and an upfront estimate

platform_agents.name: Brand Intelligence
platform_agents.role: Learns fonts, colours, tone and writing rules from your brand guidelines and checks drafts

platform_agents.name: QA & Fact-Check
platform_agents.role: Reviews every deliverable against the brief and brand and fact-checks claims

platform_agents.name: Document Studio
platform_agents.role: Renders the final branded file and new versions on revision

capabilities.name: Brand Intelligence
capabilities.what: Upload brand guidelines, logo and templates; fonts, colours, tone of voice and writing style are applied to every deliverable.

capabilities.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
capabilities.what: An orchestrator breaks the job into sub-tasks, assigns specialists and synthesises one coherent deliverable.

capabilities.name: Multi-Format Output
capabilities.what: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, CSV and Markdown.

capabilities.name: AI-Powered Quality Assurance
capabilities.what: Every deliverable passes a QA review agent and a fact-checking layer before it reaches you.

capabilities.name: Revision Workflow
capabilities.what: Request revisions like you would with a real contractor; each revision is a new version of the file.

delivery_modes.name: Standalone SaaS web app
delivery_modes.how: Browse agents, submit jobs, track progress and download deliverables; Google Sign-In; credit-based pay-per-job.

delivery_modes.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Marketplace
delivery_modes.how: The same agents appear inside the customer's Gemini Enterprise; billing runs through their Gemini Enterprise subscription.

delivery_notes: Both modes run on Wursta's infrastructure on Google Cloud, so customers only ever see the outputs (IP protection). Agents interoperate over the A2A protocol.

formats.pdf: PDF (in the product; this prototype delivers .docx)

not_for.why: Agent Workforce is not a general chatbot — it delivers finished documents per job.
Agent Workforce is not a workflow automation tool.
Agent Workforce is not a platform for building custom agents — you hire specialists, you don't build them.
Agent Workforce is not a design tool (Media is an experimental department).
Agent Workforce does not replace Docs or Word — it delivers files you open in them.
